feature: Add JSDoc documentation to SDK services (22+ undocumented services)
description: The client-sdk has 30+ services but only 11 have any JSDoc documentation (63 total tags). Critical services like gdpr.service.ts, notification-system.service.ts, economy.service.ts, pricing.service.ts, and season.service.ts lack method-level documentation with @param, @returns, and @example tags.
